consents.heading: Analysis consents
consents.intro: Video and expression processing are off until you turn each purpose on. Toggles are specific: pose/face landmarks, optional expression signals, and optional 30-day detailed tracking. No emotions are inferred.
consents.needsVideo: Turn on video analysis first. Expression signals and detailed tracking are not used without it.
consents.revoked: This purpose was revoked. Latest state is off.

accountRights.heading: Your data
accountRights.intro: Download a zip of your sessions, scores, evidence, transcripts, plans, and consents. Media links in the zip expire after 24 hours. Deleting your account starts a 7-day grace period; after that everything is hard-deleted and we email a confirmation.
accountRights.deleteConfirm: Delete your account after 7 days? You can cancel until then. After the grace period we hard-delete your data and send a confirmation email.
accountRights.pending: Account deletion is scheduled for {due}. You can still use the account until then.

aiProviders.heading: AI providers
aiProviders.intro: The default is LM Studio on TIGER (local OpenAI-compatible, Qwen). xAI/Grok is optional. Cloud keys stay in the server environment or a secret manager — they are never typed here or stored in the repo. Transcripts go to the selected provider.

hints.xai: Optional. Uses XAI_API_KEY or LLM_API_KEY. The app boots without this key.
hints.local: Owner-chosen default (16 Oct 2026). LM Studio on TIGER serving qwen/qwen3.8-27b. Base URL from LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL. No API key. Data stays on the machine when the URL is loopback.
hints.custom: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. Set CUSTOM_LLM_API_KEY or LLM_API_KEY if the host requires a key.

retention.heading: Recording retention
retention.intro: Original uploads are deleted after 30 days by default. Analysis working copies (16 kHz audio and the analysis proxy) are always removed when a job finishes. Scores and the report stay until you delete the session.

keys.until_delete: Keep until I delete the session

hints.after_analysis: Removes the original recording as soon as the report is ready. Playback may remain so you can review the session.
hints.days_30: Default. A nightly sweeper deletes originals whose retention date has passed.
hints.until_delete: Originals stay until you delete the session. Object-storage lifecycle rules are only a backstop.

accessibility.heading: Accessibility profile
accessibility.intro: These options change which body metrics are scored. They are stored as a preference you set, never inferred from video. Unavailable metrics are shown as N/A rather than a penalty.

keys.prefers_no_video_metrics: Do not score video body metrics

hints.seated: Turns off sway and walking metrics.
hints.wheelchair: Treated as seated for sway and walking metrics.
hints.limited_mobility: Turns off sway, walking, and gesture-amount metrics.
hints.one_handed: Uses the visible hand only; a hidden hand is not treated as a closed posture.
hints.speech_difference: Reserved for fluency options; it does not change gesture scoring.
hints.prefers_no_video_metrics: Gestures, gaze, and related video categories stay N/A.
hints.low_vision: Does not change gesture scoring; reserved for display preferences.

keyMetricDefinitions.tm_pct_of_slot: Talk duration divided by the planned slot. Traffic-light bands follow Toastmasters timing practice (heuristic, S1).
keyMetricDefinitions.pp_wpm: Lexical words per minute of speech. The shaded band is a practitioner range; speech-rate norms depend on the type of talk (heuristic informed by S13).
keyMetricDefinitions.fl_filler_sounds_per_min: Filled pauses such as um and uh per minute of speech. At or below 5/min shows no penalty in the cited study; 12/min is clearly harmful (S12).
keyMetricDefinitions.pp_unplanned_long_pauses_per_10min: Unplanned pauses longer than the mid-sentence threshold, scaled per 10 minutes (heuristic).
keyMetricDefinitions.ec_audience_facing_ratio: Share of speaking time with the head oriented toward the audience or camera. This is a head-orientation proxy, not eye contact (heuristic).
keyMetricDefinitions.vv_pvq_median: Pitch variation quotient: standard deviation of F0 divided by mean F0 (S24).

report.fillerBenchmarks: Reference lines: 5/min (no penalty) and 12/min (harmful) from S12.

research.heading: References
research.intro: Every category card and “why this matters” tooltip links here. Claims come only from docs/research/sources.md ([S1]–[S56]).
research.mythsIntro: What Stage Coach does not claim. Source keys open the References page.

myths.no73855Body: The 7%-38%-55% ratios do not describe communication in general. Mehrabian’s experiments concerned judgments of feelings and attitudes from inconsistent messages.
myths.noEmotionBody: Facial movements are not reliable read-outs of inner emotion across people and contexts. The app reports expressions and signals only.
myths.noAccentBody: ASR accuracy differs across speaker groups. The app scores behaviors and treats ASR-derived metrics as estimates.
myths.moreNotBetterBody: Eye contact can increase resistance to persuasion in some listeners. Gesture norms are cultural. Targets are bands, not maximums.
myths.heuristicsBody: 130–160 WPM, about 90% of the slot, ≤ 25 words per slide, and 30–90 s answers are heuristics, not research claims.

research.scoringIntro: Read-only public copy of the versioned weights, curves, and category skeleton.
research.scoringReadonly: This page does not accept edits. Changes ship as a new scoring-config version.

planForm.heading: Plan a talk
planForm.intro: Describe the talk. We extract structured fields and ask at most five clarifying questions. Skip writes those as explicit assumptions — no live LLM in tests.
